# Safety Vests and More

> > Safety Vests and More is a specialized retailer offering ANSI-certified high-visibility apparel, protective workwear, safety equipment, and industrial gear from leading brands like PORTWEST and BAYSIDE.

The site focuses on workplace safety products including ANSI Class 2 and Class 3 compliant hi-vis vests, flame-resistant coveralls, cut-resistant gloves, protective footwear, and USA-made cotton safety apparel. Products meet industry standards including ANSI/ISEA 107, EN 388, and ASTM F2413 certifications for construction, industrial, and commercial work environments.

## Key Topics

- PORTWEST safety products
- BAYSIDE Made in USA apparel
- ANSI Class 2 compliance
- ANSI/ISEA 107 TYPE R CLASS 2
- High-visibility safety vests
- Reflective tape and striping
- Cut-resistant gloves (ANSI levels A1-A4)
- Mesh safety vests
- Flame-resistant workwear
- Steel toe protective boots
- Nitrile grip gloves
- 100% cotton hi-vis apparel
- EN 388 and EN ISO 21420 certifications
- Waterproof winter safety jackets
- Segmented and solid reflective striping
